title: Croydon Curfew
description: A swung 2-step garage roller at 130 BPM led by warm off-beat organ stabs that pump under a displaced TR909 kick. A chopped vocal cut and rolling sub carry the groove through two peaks split by a dubby, drum-dropped valley.
code:
setcpm(130/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3] ~ [g2,bb2,d3] ~>").s("piano").lpf(800).room(0.5).gain(saw.slow(2).range(0.3,0.85)).swingBy(0.18,8),
    s("hh*8").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.45).swingBy(0.22,8).pan(sine.range(0.35,0.65))
  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd ~ ~ [~ bd] ~ bd ~ ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.95).shape(0.25),
    s("~ ~ cp ~ ~ ~ cp ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.6).room(0.2),
    s("hh(5,8,2)").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.5).swingBy(0.24,8).cut(1).pan(sine.range(0.3,0.7)),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3] ~ [g2,bb2,d3] ~ [ab2,c3,eb3] ~ [f2,ab2,c3] ~>").s("piano").lpf(sine.slow(16).range(700,1600)).room(0.45).gain(saw.slow(2).range(0.28,0.9)).swingBy(0.18,8)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd ~ ~ [~ bd] ~ bd ~ ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(1.0).shape(0.3),
    s("~ ~ cp ~ ~ ~ cp ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.62).room(0.25),
    s("~ rim ~ rim ~ ~ rim ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.4).swingBy(0.2,8),
    s("hh(5,8,2)").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.52).swingBy(0.26,8).cut(1).pan(sine.range(0.3,0.7)),
    s("~ oh ~ ~ ~ oh ~ ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.4).cut(1),
    note("<c2 c2 g1 ab1 f1 f1 g1 g1>").s("triangle").lpf(sine.slow(8).range(400,900)).gain(0.85).shape(0.2),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] ~ [g2,bb2,d3,f3] ~ [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] ~ [f2,ab2,c3,eb3] ~>").s("piano").lpf(sine.slow(16).range(900,2000)).room(0.4).gain(saw.slow(2).range(0.3,0.95)).swingBy(0.18,8).off(0.125, x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(0.4)),
    s("think").chop(8).speed("<1 1 1.5 0.75>").vowel("<a e o>").gain(0.5).room(0.3).cut(2)
  )],
  [16, stack(
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] [f2,ab2,c3,eb3] [g2,bb2,d3,f3]>").s("swpad").n(2).lpf(sine.slow(8).range(500,1400)).room(0.7).delay(".4:.25:.6").gain(0.7),
    note("<c2 ab1 f1 g1>").s("sine").lpf(600).gain(0.8).room(0.3),
    s("think").slice(8,"0 2 4 6").speed(0.75).vowel("o").gain(0.45).room(0.5).delay(0.3).cut(2)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd ~ ~ [~ bd] ~ bd ~ [bd ~]").bank("RolandTR909").gain(1.05).shape(0.35).every(8, x=>x.ply("<1 1 1 2>")),
    s("~ ~ cp ~ ~ ~ cp ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.65).room(0.25),
    s("~ rim ~ rim ~ rim ~ rim").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.42).swingBy(0.2,8),
    s("hh(7,8,2)").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.55).swingBy(0.28,8).cut(1).crush(10).pan(sine.range(0.25,0.75)),
    s("~ oh ~ ~ ~ oh ~ ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.42).cut(1),
    note("<c2 c2 g1 ab1 f1 f1 g1 g1>").s("triangle").lpf(sine.slow(8).range(500,1100)).gain(0.9).shape(0.25),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] ~ [g2,bb2,d3,f3] ~ [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] ~ [f2,ab2,c3,eb3] ~>").s("piano").lpf(sine.slow(16).range(1100,2400)).room(0.4).gain(saw.slow(2).range(0.32,1.0)).swingBy(0.18,8).off(0.125, x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(0.45)).every(4, x=>x.rev()),
    s("think").chop(8).speed("<1 1.5 0.75 1>").vowel("<a e o i>").gain(0.55).room(0.3).cut(2)
  )],
  [12, stack(
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3] ~ [g2,bb2,d3] ~>").s("piano").lpf(800).room(0.55).delay(".4:.25:.5").gain(saw.slow(2).range(0.3,0.8)).swingBy(0.18,8),
    s("hh*8").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.4).swingBy(0.24,8).pan(sine.range(0.35,0.65)),
    note("<c2 g1>").s("sine").lpf(500).gain(0.7).room(0.4)
  )]
)
